"AI will cure cancer" is one of the most potent, seductive arguments in the race to superintelligence. I lost my mother to cancer in 2018. When someone tells me a technology might have saved her — might save someone else's mother next year — every part of me wants to believe it.

That's exactly why we need to examine the promise instead of accepting it on faith.

This week on Your Undivided Attention, we're bringing you a recent conversation @aza and I had with @Oprah  on The Oprah Podcast, where we went deep into the anti-human future that the current AI path is moving us toward.

This was an audience of about 150 people who saw a pre-screening of "The AI Doc" and afterwards joined a live Town Hall and Q&A discussion, moderated by Oprah. 

The audience members shared their own experiences with AI and asked questions that you might be wondering about you

Justin offers clear recommendations on how we need more democratic control, ownership and oversight of AI in order for it to serve the public’s interest. 👏


Justin Rosenstein (@rosenstein)
